title: Show notification only to super users in env. where copilot substitution suggestion was used
summary: A notification about retired Copilot item substitution suggestions now appears only to super users in companies that actually used the feature, preventing unnecessary warnings in unaffected environments.
key_points: Checks Feature Uptake table to determine if the retired Copilot feature was used in the current company
Skips notification entirely for companies where the feature was never used
Prevents 'Don't show again' entries in My Notifications for unaffected companies
Uses RecordRef to safely read the internal System Application Feature Uptake table
Only accessible to users with Feature Uptake read permission, effectively limiting to super users
quote: shows the notification only in companies where the feature was actually used
